coach.greeting: Hey {name}, I'm your Money Coach. You have {balance} on hand and {flow} cash flow this month. Ask me anything about your money.
coach.default: Hey {name}, here's your snapshot: {balance} on hand, {flow} cash flow this month. As a {role}, I'd focus on {goal} next. Ask me to review spending, plan savings, or grow your money.
coach.save: Based on your last month you brought in {income} and spent {expense}. That leaves a surplus of {surplus}. Your biggest categories were {cats}. Park the surplus into {goal} automatically each payday to stay consistent.
coach.invest: You have {balance} across accounts. For a {role}, keep 3 months of expenses as cash, then split the rest between a pension pot and a diversified fund. Start small and increase contributions by 1% each quarter.
coach.tax: Set aside ~20% of each incoming payment for tax so deadlines never surprise you. Tag client payments clearly and reconcile invoices weekly — your future self will thank you.
coach.smeCashFlow: Your cash position is {balance}. At your current burn of {payroll} per month, you have {runway} months of runway. Consider tightening payables or negotiating better terms with vendors.
coach.smeVendors: Your top vendor is {vendor} ({spend}). Total monthly outflows are {expense}. Review payment terms — extending from 30 to 45 days could free up significant cash.
coach.smeCompliance: Upcoming deadlines: keep an eye on MRA filing dates. Set calendar reminders now to avoid penalties. The MRA portal accepts filings up to the due date.
coach.smePayroll: Payroll is {payroll} per month for {count} people ({pct} of expenses). Benchmark: aim for payroll < 30% of revenue. Consider contractor vs employee mix for flexibility.
coach.entrepreneurFundraising: You have {balance} cash and burn {burn} per month — {runway} months runway. To raise, you will need 18-24 months runway post-close. Start investor conversations 6 months before you need the money.
coach.entrepreneurBurn: Monthly burn is {burn} (burn multiple: {multiple}x revenue). Target burn multiple < 2x for efficient growth. Every hire should have a clear ROI path.
coach.entrepreneurHiring: Team is {count} people with {payroll} monthly payroll vs {revenue} revenue. Revenue per employee: {revPerEmp}. Before hiring, define the 90-day outcome for each role.
coach.entrepreneurRevenue: MRR is {mrr}, burn is {burn}. Annual revenue range: {range}. Focus on net revenue retention > 100% and CAC payback < 12 months.
coach.femaleFounderGrants: Check the Female Innovators Seed Fund (applications quarterly), SheWins Africa, and local women entrepreneur incentives. Deadlines are in your Insights tab.
coach.freelancerInvoices: Monthly income {income} with DSO of {dso} days. Target DSO < 30. Send reminders at day 7, 14, 21. Consider 2/10 net 30 terms to accelerate collection.
coach.freelancerTax: Set aside {taxReserve} (20% of {income}) for tax each month. Use a separate 'Tax Shield' goal with auto-contribute on every invoice payment.

philosophy.headline: YOUR MONEY IS TALKING.
philosophy.message1: Your money has an opinion. Every purchase is a vote — for what matters to you and what doesn't.
philosophy.message2: Your money has history. Patterns in how you earn and spend tell the story of your life, whether you read them or not.
philosophy.message3: Your money has potential. Most people never see the intelligence hidden in their own transactions. FINOVAULT does.

security.statement: We don't make claims we can't back up. Security and privacy are designed in from the start — because your money deserves nothing less.

principle1.title: Your data, yours
principle1.desc: You control your financial data. We never sell it, and we never give it away.

principle2.title: Local processing first
principle2.desc: Wherever possible, your information is processed on your own device.

principle3.title: Encrypted by default
principle3.desc: Your financial data is encrypted in transit and at rest.

principle4.title: No third-party sharing
principle4.desc: We do not share your data with third parties. Full stop.
